prompt: Make this photo say my script.
expected_behavior: Identify create-lipsync; request photo/script and select an actual available voice before any paid generation.

prompt: I have a portrait and want a speaking video for my intro.
expected_behavior: Identify talking-photo workflow; request image and audio or script/voice.

prompt: Sync the lips in my video to this audio recording.
expected_behavior: Identify create-lipsync; request visual and driver inputs and review estimate before generation.

prompt: My presenter’s mouth doesn’t match the new narration. Can you fix it?
expected_behavior: Identify lipsync; ask for source video and replacement audio.

prompt: Translate and dub my English video into Spanish with matching lips.
expected_behavior: Identify create-translate-and-dub; confirm target language and combined estimate with excluded provider charges.

prompt: I want a French-speaking version of this product demo, with the presenter’s lips matching.
expected_behavior: Identify Translate & Dub; clarify video and configuration.

prompt: Change one word in my video but keep my voice.
expected_behavior: Identify timed-word Edit Dialogue; obtain transcript and edit choice before preview; do not substitute full-script TTS.

prompt: I said Tuesday instead of Thursday on camera. Can you fix that without rerecording?
expected_behavior: Identify Edit Dialogue; ask for source video and review the timed-word change.

prompt: Open Sync so I can choose my media.
expected_behavior: Call open-sync-app; no generation or credit spend; do not claim rendered UI without evidence.

prompt: Add Spanish subtitles only. Keep the original audio and video unchanged.
expected_behavior: Do not call a lipsync or Translate & Dub generation; explain the supported scope.

prompt: I only want an MP3 voiceover, no image or video.
expected_behavior: Do not call create-lipsync; do not invent a hosted standalone TTS tool.

prompt: Trim the first ten seconds and add background music.
expected_behavior: Do not call lipsync/translation/dialogue tools as a substitute for general timeline editing.

prompt: Replace every line of dialogue with this completely different script using Edit Dialogue.
expected_behavior: Explain timed-word editor limits; do not promise unrestricted whole-script replacement.

prompt: Show me my previous videos. Don’t make anything new.
expected_behavior: Use project/history reads or open UI; no paid actions.
